profile.headline: SWE StackAdapt | Ex-Kochava | Ex-IBM | Focused on AI and Open Source Technology
profile.summary:
I’m a technology leader and builder who likes working at the intersection of engineering, product, and emerging technology.

Over the course of my career, I’ve helped build and lead engineering organizations through periods of rapid growth, technical change, and transformation. I’ve worked across ad tech, measurement, payments, developer infrastructure, AI, distributed systems, and open source — from high-volume production systems to early-stage ideas that are still being figured out.

I’m at my best when the problem isn’t completely defined yet.

I enjoy taking complex technical problems, understanding what actually matters to the business and the customer, and turning them into systems and teams that can move quickly without sacrificing engineering quality. I care deeply about architecture and technology, but I’m equally interested in the people, product decisions, and organizational systems that make great engineering possible.

I’ve spent much of my career in ad tech and data-intensive systems, including engineering leadership at Kochava, where I worked on large-scale measurement and attribution platforms.

More recently, I’ve worked on AI and WebAssembly infrastructure, developer tooling, and open-source projects — including building systems designed around portable, composable software and new ways of running AI and agent workloads.

I still love to build. I regularly experiment with Go, Rust, AI, distributed systems, developer tools, and whatever interesting problem happens to catch my attention. Some projects become products. Some become open source. Some are just experiments. 

Today, my focus is on building high-performing engineering teams and solving difficult technical problems while staying close enough to the code and architecture to understand how things really work.

I’m particularly interested in:
• Engineering leadership and high-performing teams
• Distributed systems and infrastructure
• Ad tech, identity, measurement, and payments
• AI, agents, and emerging developer platforms
• WebAssembly and portable runtimes
• Open source and developer tooling
• Robotics

I believe the best engineering leaders are still curious builders — people who can zoom out far enough to see the organization and product, while still being willing to zoom all the way in and understand the code.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer & Software Architect
positions.description:
- Created technical specs, project timelines and lead scrums
- Mentored junior developers 
- Developed legacy software migration plans 
- research new technology to apply within our technology stack ( gRPC, Kafka, K8s, Queuing technologies etc..) 
- Partnered with product and other engineering orgs to design and delivery production system. 
- Met with stakeholders to discuss new product and system requirements

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed Rest APIs using golang to support millions of requests a minute 
- Create and refactor existing golang projects to meet industry standards.
- Create real time metrics dashboards using InfluxDB and DataDog 
- Developed unit and integration tests plans for existing applications to reduce code complexity and down time. 
- Deployed applications to cloud environments using Gitlab CI, Jenkins, Spinnaker and Docker. 
- Participated in on call rotation for core applications

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer & Software Architect ( Kochava Labs )
positions.description:
- Designed and lead implementation of a distributed ledger project
- Developed byzantine fault tolerant consensus protocol base on PBFT
- Developed web assembly runtime in golang to support smart contracts 
- Developed peer to peer network library written in golang using TCP/TLS 
- Developed peer to peer membership library based on SWIM written in golang using UDP
- Implemented smart contract sdk written in rust for our distributed ledgers virtual machine 
- Worked directly with CEO and CFO to align project with strategic initiatives
- Managed multiple remote and local developers 
- Created technical specs, project timelines and lead scrums

positions.title: Lead Build/Automation Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed Continuous Integration and Deployment pipeline using Jenkins, Docker and Chef. 
- Created and Refactored existing ant and maven projects to fit standards and simplify build process.
- Managed source control repositories using git, and cvs.
- Managed development environments ( DB2, WebSphere MQ, RHEL ).
- Provided application detailed design documents.
- Developed in house tools to improve quality of life for developers and improve development cycle

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Design and develop integration test project for internal application using testng, junit and other java test frameworks
- Manage and support Jenkins continuous integration lab used to stream line release cycles
- Analyzed customer tickets to prevent and fix software bugs using Java for a large B2B Cloud EDI translation platform.
- Automated application metric reports using python

positions.title: Independent Studies - Research Assistant AViDA
positions.description:
- Research assistant focusing on computer graphics and virtual reality
- Integration of OpenSceneGraph with VRUI virtual reality development toolkit
- Used C++ and OpenGL to create virtual shopping experience for marketing research
- Experience with optitrack infrared sensors, data gloves and other virtual reality devices.
- Development done in linux using cmake and make.
- Met with project sponsor to discuss project direction and progression

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
- Worked on Sense and Avoid projects for UAS
- Development support and code enhancements for existing Java and C++ tools 
- Developed  plugins in Java for ImageJ to enhance data analysis
- Collected and analyzed GPS and flight data
- Developed SQL database tables used to query flight data

positions.title: Web Developer Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Completed customer tickets associated with provided products 
- Implementation and design of web applications
